title: Clipp Restaurant Order Management
tagline: AI-powered order management platform connecting restaurant buyers with food distributors and suppliers.
description: Engineered real-time order tracking, inventory management, and B2B payment processing for restaurant buyers and their suppliers.
architecture: Event-driven mobile architecture with WebSocket streaming for live order and inventory updates, plus multi-method payment gateway integrations.
highlights: Delivered real-time order tracking and supplier inventory sync across iOS and Android
Engineered fault-tolerant B2B payment flows supporting ACH, credit card, and cash
Reduced cold start latency and improved battery consumption during active ordering sessions
